resource_contract.roots: One scene's immutable hydrated roots, including all 64 menu roots or the logo root. Bank ownership retained; descriptor/shallow-view borrows remain live through actual GPU retirement.
resource_contract.mapping: Checked host bank membership -> bounded byte offset -> caller numeric guest base -> checked physical RDRAM identity. A host pointer is never cast to a guest address.
resource_contract.installation: Selected exact texture/TLUT extents only, canonical bytes converted into caller word-swapped RAM. No descriptor/code/full-bank overlay installation; no color normalization, CPU blit or decoded image substitution.
resource_contract.composed_residency: install_composed(words,epoch,immutable,reservations) validates the entire immutable selected union, both dynamic variants, all task/framebuffer reservations and host source/destination nonaliasing before any RAM/cache write. Immutable overlaps require identical source-byte identity, not equal contents. ROM bytes copy only for a new RAM epoch; dynamic uploads copy exactly bytes whose published revision exceeds this producer's resident revision. Residency commits after all uploads. validate_residency/commit_residency remain the no-copy immutable composition seam with move-only authority; tokens pin dynamic storage, stale/foreign/consumed authority throws before residency change.
resource_contract.layout: Original TEXSHUF odd-row bytes installed unchanged, LoadBlock dxt=0. Other layouts use pitch-preserving LoadTile; CI4 loads bytes and renders nibbles. Short stored pieces do not read invented nominal rows.
resource_contract.palette_upload: CI4/8 palette source images remain RGBA16. The TLUT load tile uses size0, independently of source size2, so each entry reaches all four TMEM banks. Explicit startTLUT/nTLUT and CI4 bitmap palette-bank bounds remain checked. Actual bank0 red and independent bank3 blue, tint and restoration are exercised; no stale-bank or caller-specific workaround.
resource_contract.oversized_source: Three reached 32x68 RGBA16 menu bitmaps exceed 4 KiB TMEM. Bounded bands retain upper AND lower filtered border rows with disjoint screen coverage; even-row interleave parity and 64-bit source alignment remain intact. Load windows follow whole-texel fractional-origin changes, while local texture origins retain the fractional remainder. A 32x68 RGBA16 plane with frac_t=-16 draws bands 0..60 and 60..68, loads rows 0..64 and 58..68, and samples local T=-0.5 and 1.5 respectively.
resource_contract.frame: Caller supplies ordered Draw resource-index/shallow-view pairs, viewport/scissor, command arena, reservations and exclusive RAM epoch. Preflight precedes every write. No frame allocation, asset byte rescan/copy or cache growth.

minification_lowering.selection: Representable S5.10 derivatives and normal S10.5 origins retain existing float32 arithmetic and encoded values. Only overflowing axes are decomposed independently into destination sample cells. No source scalar clamp/hide, signed-field wrap, CPU pixels, per-frame allocation or arbitrary geometry snap.
minification_lowering.numeric_contract: For an overflowing axis, D=trunc(1024/exact-float-scale) is evaluated in required IEEE binary64, never host-dependent long double and never encoded. Conceptual S10.5 origin is trunc(base+(quarterBound/4-geometricMinimum)*D/32), retaining signed flip, bitmap s/t, fractional origin, TEXSHIFT and load-window offsets. For native integer sample (p,q), S=ss+floor(Dx*(4*p-left)/128), T=tt+floor(Dy*(q-floor(top/4))/32). Only the overflowing axis is replaced with that signed16 sample origin and derivative0; the other axis stays unchanged. The conceptual intermediate origin need not fit signed16, but every emitted origin must, otherwise complete preflight rejects before any RAM write.
minification_lowering.minified_load_windows: On overflowing Y with oversized TMEM bands, actual consumed global T extrema (including the asymmetric fractional-Y anchor) choose the aligned load window, not nominal source-band geometry. The window retains floor(T/32) and its next bilerp neighbor, clamped only at true bitmap edges; local origins are rebased by exactly32*(oldLoadFirst-newLoadFirst) after original-origin truncation. Source alignment, odd-row parity, bounded loads and preflight errors remain strict. CPU and actual native RSP/RDP cases independently require global row64/63 and resident neighbors for a128x128 plane at signed1/64.
minification_lowering.coverage_and_state: In the producer's fixed non-AA/non-perspective/non-LOD, TEXEL0-only normal-cycle state, consumed samples in quarter bounds [L,R) are p=ceil(L/4)..ceil(R/4)-1. Splits retain original quarter coverage within each occupied integer cell and omit only sample-empty cells. Bilerp keeps the same consumed S10.5 phase and neighbors. COPY remains unscaled and uses its original path. Fragment emission reuses each existing TMEM load and complete capacity preflight; fragmentation count is not an API guarantee.
minification_lowering.unqualified_limits: Actual consumer proof covers canonical native1x and fixed modes() state, not AA, internally upscaled RDP sampling, interlace, perspective, texture LOD or texel1/pipelined neighbor consumption. The existing asymmetric fractional-Y and per-piece/band origin convention is preserved, not repaired: independently quantized fractional-top split and unsplit source topologies are not generally phase-equivalent. Genuine emitted-coordinate overflow, reciprocal precision loss on the normal path and existing unsupported state remain explicit errors. No unobserved SDK-producer equivalence or independent Original numerical parity is asserted.

resource_contract.attributes: Hidden, transparent, alpha compare, primitive depth, signed scale/flip, copy, half-texel shift and fractional origin supported. EXTERN and undocumented SP_OVERLAP bit reject explicitly; neither occurs in the admitted initial 65 roots or source menu attribute assignments. FASTCOPY is unscaled/non-Z per public hardware constraints; RGBA32 COPY explicitly rejects during preflight before any RAM write.
resource_contract.immutable_fields: Immutable bitmap arrays/layout, formats, TEXSHUF and palettes remain strict. Mutable UI uses Raster's explicit separately owned primary/alternate allocations and stable descriptor arrays, never mutable immutable-bank aliases or per-glyph Producer reconstruction. Raster supports bounded RGBA16/32 and IA4/8/16 planes; construction checks distinct physical/host storage and complete fixed topology. Register compiles both variants once; Draw(resource,view,generation) explicitly rebinds one variant.
resource_contract.ownership: Producer::Borrow pins every registered raster until actual GPU completion/readback, not just preparation return. Mutable span acquisition/publication and register/unregister reject live borrowers; uncommitted prepared tokens also pin storage. At most128 high-water reusable registration slots and4096 pieces per source; retired unregister compacts compiled pieces, invalidates generations and releases the actual shared backing-storage owner. Pixel change revisions are monotonic and byte-exact; no history overflow loses a changed span. Epoch changes require reinstall after caller RAM reuse.
